notes.title: Distortions is finally working on Radeon again!!!
notes.notes: [p]After the latest Windows driver update, AMD finally fixed a long-standing issue affecting OpenGL games and that includes [i]Distortions[/i]! 🙌[/p][p]It’s amazing to see this finally resolved. For years, we had to tell players the game only worked well on NVIDIA GPUs. We contacted AMD multiple times, hoping for a fix… and now, it’s here![/p][p]Players using the [b]RX 7800XT[/b] and [b]RX 6700[/b] have reported the game is running smoothly. If you’re using a Radeon GPU, let us know how it’s working for you too![/p]

notes.title: Our next game: Chenen: The Geomancy Trail
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32002412/1eca4984d53a8a91b4b73e885e6645030e75bfd9.jpg"][/img]Since January, we’ve been working on our next game: [b]Chenen: The Geomancy Trail[/b].
The truth is, we actually started writing down the first concepts about a year before that.[/p][p]Without a doubt, this is the most [b]bold and ambitious project[/b] we’ve taken on so far.
And to be honest... it’s been a constant mix of [b]fear and excitement[/b].[/p][p]The core conceptual words that guided our first project, [b]Distortions[/b], were: [b]contemplation[/b] and [b]horror[/b].
For our next project, [b]Albatroz[/b], they were: [b]freedom[/b] and [b]grief[/b].[/p][p]Now, with [b]Chenen[/b], they are: [b]silence[/b], [b]solitude[/b], and [b]fury[/b].[/p][p]This game is a [b]continuation of the design philosophy[/b] we started with Distortions,
and also the [b]next chapter in the Giants' narrative arc[/b],
introducing a [b]new Giant: Chenen[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Chenen[/b] is a [b]Traversal RPG[/b] about [b]creation[/b], [b]destruction[/b],
and a lingering question:
[b]Who truly owns the land beneath your feet?[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32002412/736939ecbbbcc3864f81fb359924eac14c45fad4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32002412/2b0d81d91bf54bc064954b26194e423e35ac25af.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32002412/4ec8ac2935daf078c98795ff755822dfb18d2582.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32002412/fc50ac856a786396399693d0f2dd95e0e70ca3d9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32002412/b679b4d140d4fc86236d79e75bc3777b32a081fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Distortions - OpenGL Issues on AMD Radeon / some ARC GPUs + Solution Using Zink
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32002412/a81d5a2eb08ca6427ed1ac9ab449149ab6c30095.jpg[/img]About GPU Compatibility Issues (OpenGL – AMD Radeon & Intel ARC)

Distortions runs on OpenGL, and some GPUs — particularly AMD Radeon and Intel ARC — may have limited or unstable support for this graphics API.

The game was developed using an engine called C4 Engine, which has been discontinued since 2016. On top of that, we built our own custom tools within this engine, making updates and compatibility fixes more complex.

In recent years, changes to AMD Radeon drivers have caused Distortions to malfunction on certain Radeon GPUs. Despite our efforts, we were unable to identify the root cause of the issue. We reached out to AMD for support but unfortunately received no response.

Intel ARC GPUs also have limited OpenGL support, which may lead to crashes or visual issues when launching the game.

We understand how frustrating this can be and appreciate your patience. For those affected, we’ve included a possible workaround using the Zink OpenGL-to-Vulkan layer (see post above).

A special thanks to demitriusbelai for discovering this workaround.

[b]🛠️ Compatibility Tip – Distortions (OpenGL Issues on Some GPUs)[/b]

If you're experiencing issues running [i]Distortions[/i] — such as black screen, crashes, or graphical glitches — this may be due to limited [b]OpenGL support[/b] on some GPUs, including [b]Intel ARC[/b] and certain [b]AMD cards[/b].

A possible workaround is to use [b]Zink[/b], an OpenGL-over-Vulkan layer that can improve compatibility on these systems.

[b]For Windows:[/b]  
You can find a Mesa3D build with Zink support here:  
[url=https://github.com/pal1000/mesa-dist-win/releases]https://github.com/pal1000/mesa-dist-win/releases[/url]

[b]For Linux:[/b]  
If you're using Mesa drivers, you can enable Zink by launching the game with the following environment variable:

[code]MESA_LOADER_DRIVER_OVERRIDE=zink %command%[/code]

This might help if the game doesn’t start or behaves incorrectly with your default drivers.

Use only if you're having issues — no changes are needed if the game runs fine on your system.

notes.title: THE MUSIC ROOM - New Feature
notes.notes:
Hey guys the new feature "the music room" is finally here.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32002412/9c608e2130f47ca551e78f509867e0028b88507e.jpg[/img]

This feature was asked several times through our community and we thought that would be a cool idea to add this feature in.
You can select the music room trough the main menu, be aware that you first need to finish the game to be able to acess it.
If you already finished the game, you just need to load the last save point of the game just before the final fight and save it again. Then go back to the main menu and acess the music room.
In the music room you can play again the key musical moments of the game. 
Like the "play be ear" or the the entirely final sequence.
We hope that you guys will like it.
And just remembering if you guys want any cool feature please let us know!!

notes.title: New DLC - Beyond Distortions.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32002412/a81d5a2eb08ca6427ed1ac9ab449149ab6c30095.jpg[/img]

Go beyond the game experience with this DLC, where you'll get access to more than 2gb of content such as music, game art, and making of files for Distortions spanning over nine years of development.

Here are the features included in the Beyond Distortions DLC.

- Documentary, "Inside Distortions". 3 full episodes recorded during the last year of production. (MP4 files, with .STR subtitles in English)

- Music files (mp3 and wave files)

- Concept Art (JPG files)

- Concept Art Character Studies for the girl, monster, masked one, the writer, journal (JPG files)

- Making Of - Pictures and movies covering the production from 2008 to 2017 (JPEG and MP4 files)

- Journal - All the journal pages! The standard pages, special pages and the writer records from the museum and collectable pages. (JPG files)

- Journal, printable version, to carry with you. Two versions of the journal - one printable version for home user, and one professional version to be to be printed on professional printing equipment. (JPG and PDF files)

- Maps - All the maps of the game, including a huge map (47mb) of the whole game. (JPG files)

- Fan Art - Fan art that our friends sent to us (JPG files)

[b]Content[/b]
Concept arts - 57 jpgs
Fan art - 9 jpgs
Records from the writer - 24 jpgs
Journal pages - 29 jpgs
Special pages - 6 jpgs
Journal professional printable version - 1 pdf
Journal home printable version - 1 jpgs
Journal colectable pages 9 jpgs
Maps - 3 jpg
Musics - 5 mp3 and 5 wavs 
Making off - 17 movies in mp4 and 64 jpgs
Documentary - Inside Distortions - 3 movies in mp4, english subtitle in str

notes.title: COMPENDIUM AND DEVROOM - New features
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32002412/b69fc1b42614a5fb94051da3aa6b742972cdd60b.png[/img]

Hey guys.
We have two new really cool features for you.
On the last update we added the "compendium" and the "devroom".
The compendium it´s a place where you can check all the pages that you found in the game.
It´s possible to acess it at any moment in the game from the new game menu.
And if you manage to find all the pages and special pages in the game you will grant acess to the devroom. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32002412/02ba43a3d1aa47338041fb65537c4449b83b3f02.png[/img]

The devroom is a place that show the background of the game, like the tools that we developed, pictures from the production, musics and more. We have plans to update it with new things from time to time. 

We are still updating the game daily, fixing and polishing everything as fast as we can.

The compendium was a feature that the community asked for us, we will continue to add new features and polishing the game.
So if you want some really cool feature please let us know.

And like always if you have any issue please just report us as well, and we will fix it right away.

Thanks friends!
